build: main with stock quic-go v0.61.0, built in the job (e2e.yml dispatch input throughput, branch rel-pr-06-final: real server, real edge, two pb daemons in containers on an idle 4-core ubuntu-latest runner)
method: 50 ms netem (limit 100000) on the origin container's egress BEFORE it pairs, 200 MiB file, 3 downloads through an ephemeral tunnel on the real edge, median vs 150 Mbit/s
earlier_failures_explained: 88-95 Mbit/s runs had the 50 ms applied after the origin's QUIC connection existed: its handshake measured 1 ms, so its min RTT stayed ~1 ms and quic-go's HyStart left slow start 50 ms into the transfer at a 40 KB window (qlog trace: zero loss, cwnd 107 KB after 1 s, then Reno growth ~16 KB/s, bytes in flight = cwnd). With the delay present at the handshake (srtt 50, min 50) the same code gives 180+. The old harness restarted the carrier unit but the connection belongs to the user daemon.
residual: A connection whose path RTT rises long after the handshake still exits slow start early (quic-go HyStart; quic-go issue 5952 on app-limited marking is open); real machines handshake at their real RTT.
